title: The Private Files of Rex Saunders
identity_notes: Short-lived NBC detective/adventure vehicle starring Rex Harrison as Rex Saunders with Leon Janney as assistant Alec. Frozen collection has thirteen regular broadcast recordings plus the April 13 Game With Death audition; the regular May 23 episode-4 slot lacks a distinct frozen network aircheck.

historical_context.title: Edited Rex Saunders preservation copies
historical_context.description: Several circulating recordings are materially shorter than indexed NBC runtimes, consistent with later commercial/system-cue or syndication editing.

historical_context.title: Rex Harrison radio star vehicle
historical_context.description: The program was built around film/stage star Rex Harrison as a polished globe-aware private investigator.

historical_context.title: April 1951 Game With Death audition
historical_context.description: Game With Death survives in Wade archive as the April 13 audition/rehearsal preceding the regular May run.

historical_context.title: 1951 NBC/RCA Victor Rex Saunders run
historical_context.description: Fourteen weekly NBC detective/adventure broadcasts starred Rex Harrison and Leon Janney and were sponsored by RCA Victor.
